description: PUBLIC: anyone can see the saved page. Publish a completed report to the public website after the user asks to save it. Use the reportId returned by report, a public slug, and client-authored page and presentation choices. Never submit or invent result numbers. Adds it to the strategy directory without rerunning the strategy. Existing slugs require expectedKey to replace a different result. setAsHome changes the home page only when explicitly requested.

expectedKey.description: Current published key, required only when replacing a different saved result at this slug.

id.description: Public page slug. New slugs add a page; existing slugs require expectedKey to replace.

chartSeries.description: Additional price-panel plots. Reference named engine report series. Set a legend label, line or bar type, line pattern, and optional hex color.

strategyExplanation.description: In 1 to 3 plain sentences, explain what the strategy trades, what triggers buys and sells or rebalancing, and one key assumption when relevant. Use the run rules. Leave historical results for the report.

reportId.description: The reportId returned by report. Do not submit prices, trades, or statistics.

setAsHome.description: Also select this strategy for the home page. Otherwise preserve the current home strategy.

name: save_strategy
title: Publish a report to the public website
